verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global-employment SaaS platform with an API and embeddable components, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only the API, webhooks, sandboxes, EOR workflows and pricing. Nothing documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
